title: To‘xtamasdan 2 daqiqa gapirish texnikasi
goal_uz: Dars oxirida notanish mavzu bo‘yicha bir daqiqada g‘oya topasiz, fikrni misol va qarama-qarshilik bilan kengaytirasiz, xatoni to‘xtamasdan tuzatasiz va tabiiy to‘ldiruvchi iboralar yordamida 2 daqiqa uzluksiz gapira olasiz.

vocab.w: let me put it another way

scenes.title: Ikki daqiqa: qo‘rqmasdan
board: Speaking for 2 minutes without stopping
(To‘xtamasdan 2 daqiqa gapirish)
ideas · expansion · repair · fillers
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda modal fe’llarning ilg‘or ma’nolarini o‘rgandik: must have, should have, needn’t have. Bugun amaliy ko‘nikma: to‘xtamasdan ikki daqiqa gapirish. Dars oxirida bir daqiqada g‘oya topasiz, fikrni misol va qarama-qarshilik bilan kengaytirasiz, xatoni to‘xtamay tuzatasiz va tabiiy to‘ldiruvchilardan foydalanasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we explored advanced modal meanings. Today, a practical skill: speaking for two minutes without stopping.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar modallarning ilg‘or ma’nolarini o‘rgandik. Bugun amaliy ko‘nikma: to‘xtamasdan ikki daqiqa gapirish.

scenes.title: Muammo tilda emas
board: The problem is rarely grammar.
It’s ideas + panic.
Fluency > perfection
scenes.say_native: C1 darajasida sizda so‘z ham, grammatika ham yetarli. Ikki daqiqa gapirishga xalaqit beradigan narsa boshqa: g‘oya tugab qoladi yoki xato qilishdan qo‘rqib, to‘xtab qolasiz. Masalan, IELTS speaking ikkinchi qismida bir daqiqa tayyorlanib, bir-ikki daqiqa gapirasiz. Bugun to‘rtta texnikani o‘rganamiz: g‘oya topish, kengaytirish, o‘zini tuzatish va to‘ldiruvchilar.
scenes.say: At this level, the problem is rarely grammar. It's running out of ideas, or freezing because you're afraid of mistakes. Fluency comes before perfection.
scenes.say_uz: Bu darajada muammo kamdan-kam grammatikada bo‘ladi. G‘oya tugaydi yoki xatodan qo‘rqib qotib qolasiz. Ravonlik mukammallikdan oldin keladi.

scenes.title: G‘oya topish: 5W + H
board: Who? What? Where? When? Why? How?
Topic: a place you love
→ who with · what you do · when you go · why it matters
scenes.say_native: Birinchi mavzu: g‘oya topish. Eng oddiy va ishonchli usul: oltita savol. Who, what, where, when, why, how. Mavzu sevimli joy bo‘lsa: u yerga kim bilan borasiz, nima qilasiz, qachon borasiz, nega u siz uchun muhim, qanday topgansiz. Har bir savolga bitta so‘z yozsangiz, oltita kichik bo‘lim tayyor. Har bo‘limga yigirma soniya gapirsangiz, ikki daqiqa to‘ladi.
scenes.say: The simplest technique: ask yourself who, what, where, when, why and how. Six questions give you six mini-sections. Twenty seconds each, and you've filled two minutes.
scenes.say_uz: Eng oddiy usul: o‘zingizga kim, nima, qayerda, qachon, nega va qanday deb savol bering. Olti savol olti kichik bo‘lim beradi. Har biriga yigirma soniya va ikki daqiqa to‘ladi.

scenes.title: Namunaviy qaydlar
board: Topic: a place you love → Chorsu Bazaar
who: grandmother · what: spices, bread
when: Saturday mornings · why: smells = childhood
how: first went at age six
scenes.say_native: Mana bir daqiqalik qaydlar namunasi. Mavzu: sevimli joy, Chorsu bozori. Who, buvim bilan. What, ziravor va non. When, shanba ertalab. Why, hidlari bolaligimni eslatadi. How, olti yoshimda birinchi marta borganman. E’tibor bering, hammasi bir-ikki so‘z, to‘liq gap emas. Tayyorlanish vaqtida gap yozmang, faqat kalit so‘zlar.
scenes.say: Chorsu Bazaar. I first went there with my grandmother when I was six, and we still go on Saturday mornings. The smell of spices and fresh bread takes me straight back to my childhood.
scenes.say_uz: Chorsu bozori. Olti yoshimda buvim bilan birinchi marta borganman va hali ham shanba ertalab boramiz. Ziravor va yangi non hidi meni darhol bolaligimga qaytaradi.

scenes.title: O‘tmish, hozir, kelajak
board: Past: How did it start?
Present: What is it like now?
Future: How might it change?
+ personal → general → opinion
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi usul: vaqt chizig‘i. O‘tmish: qanday boshlangan? Hozir: hozir qanday? Kelajak: qanday o‘zgarishi mumkin? Bu usul ayniqsa texnologiya, shahar yoki odatlar haqidagi mavzularda yaxshi ishlaydi. Uchinchi usul: shaxsiydan umumiyga. Avval o‘z tajribangiz, keyin umuman odamlar, oxirida fikringiz. Bu uch qadam nutqqa tabiiy oqim beradi.
scenes.say: Another technique is a timeline: how it started, what it's like now, how it might change. Or zoom out: start with your own experience, move to people in general, and finish with your opinion.
scenes.say_uz: Yana bir usul vaqt chizig‘i: qanday boshlangan, hozir qanday, qanday o‘zgarishi mumkin. Yoki kengaytiring: o‘z tajribangizdan boshlang, umuman odamlarga o‘ting va fikringiz bilan yakunlang.

scenes.title: O‘zbek o‘quvchisining odati
board: ✗ translating in your head
✗ waiting for the perfect sentence
✗ memorised answers
✓ notes → speak → adjust
scenes.say_native: Ko‘pchiligimiz maktabda tayyor matnni yodlab gapirishga o‘rganganmiz. Natijada notanish savolga duch kelsak, avval o‘zbekcha mukammal gap tuzamiz, keyin tarjima qilamiz. Bu sekin va charchatadi. Inglizcha fikrlashga o‘tish uchun kichik bo‘laklarda gapiring: avval asosiy fikr, keyin tafsilot. Gap yarmida o‘zgarishi mumkin, bu normal. Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar ham shunday gapiradi.
scenes.say: Don't wait for the perfect sentence in your head. Start with the main idea, add details as they come, and adjust as you go. That's how native speakers talk too.
scenes.say_uz: Boshingizda mukammal gapni kutmang. Asosiy fikrdan boshlang, tafsilotlarni kelishiga qarab qo‘shing va gapira turib moslashtiring. Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar ham shunday gapiradi.

scenes.title: G‘oya tugaganda
board: ✗ silence… “I don’t know what to say.”
✗ a memorised paragraph that doesn’t fit
✓ “Another thing worth mentioning is…”
✓ “Going back to what I said earlier…”
scenes.say_native: G‘oya tugaganda ikki xato. Birinchisi: jim qolish yoki I don’t know what to say deyish. Ikkinchisi: mavzuga mos kelmaydigan yodlangan matnni aytib yuborish. To‘g‘ri yo‘l: o‘tish iborasi bilan yangi savolga o‘tish. Another thing worth mentioning is, yana bir aytib o‘tish kerak bo‘lgan narsa. Going back to what I said earlier, avval aytganimga qaytsam. Bu iboralar sizga o‘ylash uchun vaqt beradi.
scenes.say: When you run out of ideas, don't stop. Say: another thing worth mentioning is... Or: going back to what I said earlier... Then pick the next question from your notes.
scenes.say_uz: G‘oya tugasa, to‘xtamang. Ayting: yana bir aytib o‘tish kerak bo‘lgan narsa... Yoki: avval aytganimga qaytsam... Keyin qaydlaringizdan keyingi savolni oling.

scenes.title: Bir daqiqalik reja
board: Topic: a skill you would like to learn
Write 6 key words: who / what / where / when / why / how
Words only, no sentences!
scenes.say_native: Endi siz. Mavzu: o‘rganmoqchi bo‘lgan ko‘nikmangiz. Darsni to‘xtatib, bir daqiqa ichida oltita kalit so‘z yozing: kim, nima, qayerda, qachon, nega, qanday. Faqat so‘zlar, gap emas. Agar biror savolga javob topilmasa, uni o‘tkazib yuboring va vaqt chizig‘i usulidan foydalaning: o‘tmish, hozir, kelajak.
scenes.say: Topic: a skill you would like to learn. Write six key words, one for each question. Words only, no sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu: o‘rganmoqchi bo‘lgan ko‘nikmangiz. Har bir savol uchun bittadan, oltita kalit so‘z yozing. Faqat so‘zlar, gap emas.

scenes.title: Namunaviy reja
board: what: playing the dutar
who: my uncle teaches · where: his house
when: weekends · why: family tradition
how: 20 minutes a day, online videos
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy reja. What, dutor chalish. Who, amakim o‘rgatadi. Where, uning uyida. When, dam olish kunlari. Why, oilaviy an’ana, bobom ham chalgan. How, kuniga yigirma daqiqa mashq. Ko‘rib turibsizki, oltita so‘z ikki daqiqalik hikoyaning skeleti bo‘ladi. Sizning rejangiz boshqa bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi, har bir savolga kamida bitta kalit so‘z topish.
scenes.say: Here's a sample plan: playing the dutar; my uncle; his house; weekends; a family tradition; twenty minutes a day. Six words, and the skeleton of a two-minute talk.
scenes.say_uz: Mana namunaviy reja: dutor chalish; amakim; uning uyi; dam olish kunlari; oilaviy an’ana; kuniga yigirma daqiqa. Olti so‘z va ikki daqiqalik nutqning skeleti.

scenes.title: Kengaytirish formulasi
board: Point → Reason → Example → Contrast → Link back
P: I prefer trains.
R: …because I can work.
E: …last month I wrote a report on the way to Samarkand.
C: That said, flights are faster. L: Still, for me, trains win.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi mavzu: fikrni kengaytirish. Formula besh qadam: fikr, sabab, misol, qarama-qarshilik va asosiy fikrga qaytish. I prefer trains, because I can work on the way. For example, last month I wrote a whole report on the way to Samarkand. That said, flights are faster. Still, for me, trains win. Bitta oddiy fikr yarim daqiqalik nutqqa aylandi.
scenes.say: Point, reason, example, contrast, link back. I prefer trains, because I can work on the way. Last month I wrote a whole report on the way to Samarkand. That said, flights are faster. Still, for me, trains win.
scenes.say_uz: Fikr, sabab, misol, qarama-qarshilik, qaytish. Men poyezdni afzal ko‘raman, chunki yo‘lda ishlay olaman. O‘tgan oy Samarqandga ketayotib butun hisobotni yozdim. Shunday bo‘lsa-da, samolyot tezroq. Baribir, men uchun poyezd yaxshiroq.

scenes.title: Misol keltirish iboralari
board: For instance, … / Take … , for example.
A case in point is …
I remember when … (personal)
Just to give you an idea, …

examples.t: Prices have gone up. Take bread, for example: it’s doubled in two years.
examples.uz: Narxlar oshdi. Masalan, nonni oling: ikki yilda ikki baravar oshdi.

scenes.say_native: Misol uchun faqat for example deyavermang. For instance, xuddi shu ma’noda. Take bread, for example, ya’ni nonni oling. A case in point is, yorqin misol bu. Shaxsiy misol uchun: I remember when, eslayman. Just to give you an idea, tasavvur berish uchun. Eng kuchli misol aniq raqam yoki shaxsiy voqea: it’s doubled in two years. Umumiy gapdan ko‘ra aniq tafsilot ko‘proq ishontiradi.
scenes.say: Vary your example phrases. For instance. Take bread, for example. A case in point is. I remember when. Just to give you an idea. And make the example concrete: a number, a name, a moment.
scenes.say_uz: Misol iboralarini almashtirib turing. For instance. Take bread, for example. A case in point is. I remember when. Just to give you an idea. Misol aniq bo‘lsin: raqam, ism, lahza.

scenes.title: Qarama-qarshilik iboralari
board: On the other hand, …
That said, … / Having said that, …
Then again, … (yana o‘ylab ko‘rsam)
Mind you, … (BrE, informal: aytgancha)
scenes.say_native: Qarama-qarshilik nutqni chuqurroq qiladi va vaqt ham beradi. On the other hand, boshqa tomondan. That said yoki having said that, shunday bo‘lsa-da. Then again, yana o‘ylab ko‘rsam. Mind you, britancha so‘zlashuv, aytgancha, ya’ni avvalgi fikrga kichik tuzatish. Bu iboralar suhbatdoshga siz ikki tomonni ham ko‘ra olishingizni ko‘rsatadi, bu esa C1 darajasining belgisi.
scenes.say: Contrast adds depth and buys time. On the other hand. That said. Having said that. Then again. And in informal British English: mind you.
scenes.say_uz: Qarama-qarshilik chuqurlik qo‘shadi va vaqt beradi. On the other hand. That said. Having said that. Then again. Britancha so‘zlashuvda esa: mind you.

scenes.title: Kengaytirilgan javob
board: Q: Do you like living in a big city?
Mostly, yes… Take transport, for example…
Then again, … the noise…
So, on balance, …
scenes.say_native: Tinglang, formula qanday ishlaydi. Avval qisqa javob: mostly, yes. Keyin sabab va aniq misol: metro. Keyin then again bilan qarama-qarshilik: shovqin. Oxirida on balance bilan umumiy xulosa. Bu javob taxminan yarim daqiqa davom etadi. Ikki daqiqa uchun shunday to‘rtta bo‘lak kifoya.
scenes.say: Mostly, yes. Everything's close by. Take transport, for example: the metro gets me to work in fifteen minutes. Then again, the noise can be exhausting, especially in summer. So, on balance, I'd stay, but I'd love a quieter neighbourhood.
scenes.say_uz: Asosan, ha. Hamma narsa yaqin. Transportni oling: metro meni o‘n besh daqiqada ishga olib boradi. Yana o‘ylab ko‘rsam, shovqin charchatishi mumkin, ayniqsa yozda. Xullas, umuman olganda, qolardim, lekin tinchroq mahallani xohlardim.

scenes.title: Kengaytirish xatolari
board: ✗ In other hand → ✓ On the other hand
✗ Despite of the noise → ✓ Despite the noise
✗ For example, for example, for example…
✗ Example with no detail: “For example, many things.”
scenes.say_native: Tipik xatolar. In other hand emas, on the other hand. Despite of emas, despite yoki in spite of. Uchinchi xato: har gapda for example, bu monoton eshitiladi. To‘rtinchisi eng keng tarqalgan: misol iborasini aytib, aniq misol bermaslik. For example, many things, bu misol emas. Misol iborasidan keyin doim aniq narsa: ism, raqam yoki voqea.
scenes.say: On the other hand, not in other hand. Despite the noise, not despite of. Don't repeat for example in every sentence. And after an example phrase, give a real example.
scenes.say_uz: On the other hand, in other hand emas. Despite the noise, despite of emas. Har gapda for example ni takrorlamang. Misol iborasidan keyin haqiqiy misol bering.

scenes.title: Fikrni kengaytiring
board: Point: Online learning is convenient.
Add: a reason · an example · a contrast · a link back
Aim: 30 seconds
scenes.say_native: Navbat sizda. Fikr: online learning is convenient, onlayn ta’lim qulay. Formulaga ko‘ra kengaytiring: sabab, aniq misol, qarama-qarshilik va asosiy fikrga qaytish. Taxminan o‘ttiz soniya gapiring. Darsni to‘xtatib, ovoz chiqarib ayting. Bugungi iboralardan kamida bittasini ishlating: for instance, take, that said yoki then again.
scenes.say: Expand this point for thirty seconds: online learning is convenient. Add a reason, an example, a contrast and a link back.
scenes.say_uz: Bu fikrni o‘ttiz soniya kengaytiring: onlayn ta’lim qulay. Sabab, misol, qarama-qarshilik va qaytish qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: …because you can study anywhere.
Take my sister: she did a whole course on the bus.
That said, it’s easy to get distracted.
Still, for busy people, it’s ideal.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javobda besh qadam ham bor. Fikr va sabab: chunki istalgan joyda o‘qish mumkin. Aniq misol: singlim butun kursni avtobusda o‘tgan. Qarama-qarshilik: that said, chalg‘ib ketish oson. Qaytish: still, band odamlar uchun ideal. Sizning javobingizda ham shu besh qadam bo‘lsa, kengaytirish texnikasini o‘zlashtirdingiz.
scenes.say: Online learning is convenient because you can study anywhere. Take my sister: she did a whole course on the bus. That said, it's easy to get distracted at home. Still, for busy people, it's ideal.
scenes.say_uz: Onlayn ta’lim qulay, chunki istalgan joyda o‘qish mumkin. Singlimni oling: u butun kursni avtobusda o‘tgan. Shunday bo‘lsa-da, uyda chalg‘ish oson. Baribir, band odamlar uchun bu ideal.

scenes.title: Tinglash: bir daqiqalik nutq
board: Listen: Malika talks about a book
Q1 Which idea technique does she use?
Q2 What example does she give?
Q3 Which contrast phrase does she use?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Malika o‘ziga ta’sir qilgan kitob haqida gapiradi. Uch savol. Birinchi: u qaysi g‘oya topish usulidan foydalanadi? Ikkinchi: qanday aniq misol keltiradi? Uchinchi: qaysi qarama-qarshilik iborasini ishlatadi? Tuzilishga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: I'd like to talk about a book I read at school, The Little Prince. Back then, I thought it was just a children's story. Now, I see it differently. Take the fox, for example: he says you're responsible for what you've tamed. That line changed how I think about friendship. Then again, some parts still confuse me. In the future, I'd like to read it with my own children.
scenes.say_uz: Maktabda o‘qigan kitobim, Kichkina shahzoda haqida gapirmoqchiman. O‘shanda uni oddiy bolalar hikoyasi deb o‘ylardim. Hozir boshqacha ko‘raman. Masalan, tulkini oling: u qo‘lga o‘rgatgan narsang uchun javobgarsan, deydi. Bu jumla do‘stlik haqidagi fikrimni o‘zgartirdi. Yana o‘ylab ko‘rsam, ba’zi qismlari hali ham tushunarsiz. Kelajakda uni o‘z farzandlarim bilan o‘qishni xohlayman.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: Q1 Which technique organises her talk?
Q2 What specific example does she give?
Q3 Which contrast phrase does she use?
scenes.say_native: Javob bering. Birinchi: Malikaning nutqini qaysi usul tartibga solgan? Back then, now, in the future so‘zlariga e’tibor bering. Ikkinchi: u qanday aniq misol keltiradi? Uchinchi: qaysi qarama-qarshilik iborasini ishlatadi? Javobingizni inglizcha, to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Which technique organises Malika's talk? What specific example does she give? Which contrast phrase does she use?
scenes.say_uz: Malikaning nutqini qaysi usul tartibga solgan? U qanday aniq misol keltiradi? Qaysi qarama-qarshilik iborasini ishlatadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Past – present – future (back then · now · in the future)
2) The fox: “responsible for what you’ve tamed”
3) Then again
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: vaqt chizig‘i usuli, back then, now, in the future. Ikkinchi: aniq misol, tulkining so‘zlari, you’re responsible for what you’ve tamed. U take the fox, for example iborasi bilan kiritilgan. Uchinchi: then again, ba’zi qismlar hali ham tushunarsiz. Ko‘rib turibsizki, oddiy mavzu ham to‘g‘ri tuzilish bilan boy nutqqa aylanadi.
scenes.say: She uses a timeline: back then, now, in the future. Her example is the fox's line about responsibility. And her contrast phrase is then again.
scenes.say_uz: U vaqt chizig‘idan foydalanadi: o‘shanda, hozir, kelajakda. Uning misoli tulkining mas’uliyat haqidagi jumlasi. Qarama-qarshilik iborasi esa then again.

scenes.title: O‘zini tuzatish: to‘xtamasdan
board: I mean, … / or rather, …
Sorry, what I meant was …
Let me put that another way.
I went, sorry, I’ve been there twice.
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi mavzu: o‘zini tuzatish. Xato qilsangiz, gapni boshidan boshlamang. Qisqa tuzatish iborasini ishlating va davom eting. I mean, ya’ni. Or rather, to‘g‘rirog‘i: it was in May, or rather, early June. Sorry, what I meant was, kechirasiz, aytmoqchi bo‘lganim. Let me put that another way, boshqacha aytsam. Tez va qisqa tuzatish tilni nazorat qilayotganingizni ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: When you make a mistake, fix it quickly and keep going. It was in May, or rather, early June. Sorry, what I meant was... Let me put that another way.
scenes.say_uz: Xato qilsangiz, tez tuzating va davom eting. Bu mayda edi, to‘g‘rirog‘i, iyun boshida. Kechirasiz, aytmoqchi bo‘lganim... Boshqacha aytsam.

scenes.title: Qachon tuzatish kerak?
board: Fix: errors that change the meaning
Ignore: tiny slips (a / the, -s)
Never: restart the whole sentence
scenes.say_native: Har bir xatoni tuzatish shart emas. Ma’noni o‘zgartiradigan xatoni tuzating: masalan, I’ve lived here for two years demoqchi bo‘lib, two days deb yuborsangiz. Artikl yoki s qo‘shimchasi kabi kichik xatolarni esa qo‘yib yuboring, aks holda nutq uzilib-uzilib ketadi. Hech qachon butun gapni boshidan qayta boshlamang, bu ravonlikni eng ko‘p buzadi.
scenes.say: Fix mistakes that change the meaning. Let tiny slips go, or your speech will keep breaking down. And never restart the whole sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Ma’noni o‘zgartiradigan xatolarni tuzating. Kichik xatolarni qo‘yib yuboring, aks holda nutqingiz uzilib turadi. Butun gapni hech qachon boshidan boshlamang.

scenes.title: So‘z topilmasa: tavsiflang
board: It’s a kind of … / It’s a sort of …
the thing you use to …
the person who …
I can’t think of the word, but it’s …

examples.t: It’s the person who owns the flat you rent… the landlord!
examples.uz: Siz ijaraga olgan kvartiraning egasi… uy egasi!

scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p to‘xtash sababi: kerakli so‘z yodga kelmaydi. Bunda o‘zbekcha yoki ruscha so‘z qo‘shmang, tavsiflang. It’s a kind of, bu bir xil. The thing you use to, nimadir qilish uchun ishlatiladigan narsa. The person who, shunday odam. I can’t think of the word, but, so‘z yodimga kelmayapti, lekin. Ko‘pincha tavsif paytida so‘zning o‘zi ham yodga tushadi.
scenes.say: If a word won't come, describe it. It's a kind of... The thing you use to... The person who... I can't think of the word, but... Often the word comes back while you're describing it.
scenes.say_uz: So‘z yodga kelmasa, tavsiflang. Bu bir xil... Nimadir qilish uchun ishlatiladigan narsa... Shunday odamki... So‘z yodimga kelmayapti, lekin... Ko‘pincha tavsif paytida so‘z yodga tushadi.

scenes.title: Ravonlikni buzadigan odatlar
board: ✗ “Yesterday I go… no… Yesterday I… Yesterday I went…”
✗ switching to Uzbek or Russian: “…the, haligi, отвертка…”
✗ long apologies: “Sorry, sorry, my English is bad…”
✓ “Yesterday I go, sorry, went to…”
scenes.say_native: Uchta odat ravonlikni buzadi. Birinchi: gapni uch marta boshidan boshlash. Ikkinchi: o‘zbekcha haligi yoki ruscha so‘zni qo‘shib yuborish. Uchinchi: uzun uzr so‘rash, sorry, my English is bad. Bu ishonchingizni ham, tinglovchining diqqatini ham yo‘qotadi. To‘g‘risi: yesterday I go, sorry, went to the market, va davom etish. Bitta so‘z, bitta tuzatish, oldinga.
scenes.say: Don't restart three times, don't switch languages, and don't apologise for your English. Just say: yesterday I go, sorry, went to the market. One word, one fix, and move on.
scenes.say_uz: Uch marta qayta boshlamang, tilni almashtirmang va ingliz tilingiz uchun uzr so‘ramang. Shunchaki: kecha bozorga boraman, kechirasiz, bordim. Bitta so‘z, bitta tuzatish va oldinga.

scenes.title: Tuzating va tavsiflang
board: 1) Fix and continue: “I have visited Bukhara last year…”
2) Describe without the word: screwdriver
3) Describe without the word: landlord
4) Fix: “It was on Monday… (actually Tuesday)”
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta vazifa. Birinchi: I have visited Bukhara last year deb boshlang, o‘zingizni tez tuzating va davom eting. Ikkinchi: screwdriver so‘zini aytmay tavsiflang, ya’ni otvertka. Uchinchi: landlord so‘zini aytmay tavsiflang. To‘rtinchi: it was on Monday deb boshlab, aslida seshanba ekanini tuzatish iborasi bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Fix and continue: I have visited Bukhara last year. Describe a screwdriver without the word. Describe a landlord. And correct Monday to Tuesday.
scenes.say_uz: Tuzating va davom eting: I have visited Bukhara last year. Otvertkani so‘zni aytmay tavsiflang. Uy egasini tavsiflang. Dushanbani seshanbaga tuzating.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I visited, sorry, I visited Bukhara last year, and…
2) It’s the tool you use to turn screws.
3) It’s the person who owns the flat you rent.
4) It was on Monday, or rather, Tuesday.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: I have visited, sorry, I visited Bukhara last year, and it was amazing. Last year bilan past simple keladi, tuzatish qisqa. Ikkinchi: it’s the tool you use to turn screws. Uchinchi: it’s the person who owns the flat you rent. To‘rtinchi: it was on Monday, or rather, Tuesday. Hech birida gap boshidan boshlanmadi.
scenes.say: I visited, sorry, I visited Bukhara last year. It's the tool you use to turn screws. It's the person who owns the flat you rent. It was on Monday, or rather, Tuesday.
scenes.say_uz: Buxoroga bordim, kechirasiz, o‘tgan yili bordim. Bu vintlarni burash uchun ishlatiladigan asbob. Bu siz ijaraga olgan kvartira egasi. Bu dushanba, to‘g‘rirog‘i, seshanba edi.

scenes.title: Tabiiy to‘ldiruvchilar
board: Well, … / Let me think…
You know, … / I mean, …
kind of / sort of (≈ biroz, qandaydir)
✗ eee… / haligi… / это…
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi mavzu: to‘ldiruvchilar. Har bir odam gapirganda o‘ylash uchun to‘xtaydi. Farq shundaki, ona tilida so‘zlashuvchi bu pauzani inglizcha so‘z bilan to‘ldiradi: well, let me think, you know, I mean. Kind of va sort of, biroz, qandaydir: it was kind of strange. O‘zbek o‘quvchisi esa eee, haligi yoki ruscha это deydi. Bu darhol chet tildagi nutq ekanini bildiradi.
scenes.say: Everyone pauses to think. Native speakers fill the pause with English: well, let me think, you know, I mean. It was kind of strange. What gives learners away is eee, or a word from their own language.
scenes.say_uz: Har kim o‘ylash uchun to‘xtaydi. Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar pauzani inglizcha to‘ldiradi: well, let me think, you know, I mean. Bu qandaydir g‘alati edi. O‘quvchilarni esa eee yoki o‘z tilidagi so‘z fosh qiladi.

scenes.title: Vaqt yutadigan iboralar
board: That’s a tricky question.
I’ve never really thought about it, but …
It depends on what you mean by …
How can I put it? …
scenes.say_native: Uzunroq to‘ldiruvchilar savol boshida juda qulay. That’s a tricky question, qiyin savol ekan. I’ve never really thought about it, but, bu haqda hech o‘ylamagan ekanman, lekin. It depends on what you mean by, nimani nazarda tutishingizga bog‘liq. How can I put it? Qanday desam? Bular sizga ikki-uch soniya beradi, va shu orada miyangiz birinchi g‘oyani topadi.
scenes.say: Longer phrases buy you a few seconds at the start. That's a tricky question. I've never really thought about it, but... It depends on what you mean by... How can I put it?
scenes.say_uz: Uzunroq iboralar boshida bir necha soniya beradi. Qiyin savol ekan. Bu haqda hech o‘ylamagan ekanman, lekin... Nimani nazarda tutishingizga bog‘liq... Qanday desam?

scenes.title: Savolni qabul qiling
board: Start each answer with a time-buying phrase:
1) Is money the key to happiness?
2) Should school uniforms be banned?
3) What will cities look like in 2050?
scenes.say_native: Uchta qiyin savol. Har biriga darhol javob bermang: avval vaqt yutadigan ibora ayting, keyin bitta gap bilan fikringizni bildiring. Birinchi: pul baxtning kalitimi? Ikkinchi: maktab formasini bekor qilish kerakmi? Uchinchi: 2050 yilda shaharlar qanday bo‘ladi? Har safar boshqa ibora tanlang, bittasini takrorlamang.
scenes.say: Start each answer with a time-buying phrase. Is money the key to happiness? Should school uniforms be banned? What will cities look like in 2050?
scenes.say_uz: Har bir javobni vaqt yutadigan ibora bilan boshlang. Pul baxtning kalitimi? Maktab formasini bekor qilish kerakmi? 2050 yilda shaharlar qanday bo‘ladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) It depends on what you mean by happiness, but…
2) I’ve never really thought about it, but…
3) That’s a tricky question. I suppose…
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy boshlanishlar. Birinchi: it depends on what you mean by happiness, but I think money helps only up to a point. Ikkinchi: I’ve never really thought about it, but uniforms probably save families money. Uchinchi: that’s a tricky question. I suppose there will be far fewer private cars. Uchala ibora har xil, va har biridan keyin darhol aniq fikr keladi.
scenes.say: It depends on what you mean by happiness, but money helps only up to a point. I've never really thought about it, but uniforms probably save money. That's a tricky question. I suppose there'll be fewer cars.
scenes.say_uz: Baxt deganda nimani nazarda tutishingizga bog‘liq, lekin pul faqat ma’lum darajagacha yordam beradi. Bu haqda hech o‘ylamagan ekanman, lekin forma pulni tejasa kerak. Qiyin savol ekan. Menimcha, mashinalar kamroq bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: To‘ldiruvchi ham me’yorida
board: ✗ It was, like, you know, like, really, like, nice.
✗ That’s a tricky question. (every single time)
✗ actual problem (≈ актуальная) → ✓ current / pressing problem
✓ 1–2 fillers per sentence at most
scenes.say_native: To‘ldiruvchilar ham tuz kabi. Har ikki so‘zda like yoki you know desangiz, nutq bo‘sh eshitiladi. Har savolga that’s a tricky question deb boshlash ham sezilib qoladi. Yana bir tuzoq rus tilidan: актуальная проблема ni actual problem deb aytish. Inglizcha actual “haqiqiy” degani. To‘g‘risi: a current, a pressing yoki a topical problem.
scenes.say: Fillers are like salt too. Like, you know, like, every two words sounds empty. Vary your phrases. And actual means real, not current: say a pressing problem, not an actual problem.
scenes.say_uz: To‘ldiruvchilar ham tuz kabi. Har ikki so‘zda like, you know bo‘sh eshitiladi. Iboralarni almashtiring. Actual haqiqiy degani, dolzarb emas: a pressing problem deng, an actual problem emas.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: pauza va ohang
board: Well… (cho‘zilgan, tekis ohang)
you know /jə ˈnəʊ/
Pause between chunks, not inside them:
✓ I think | the main reason is | cost. ✗ I think the | main…
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz. Well ni cho‘zib, tekis ohangda aytsangiz, tinglovchi davom etishingizni tushunadi. You know da you kuchsiz, jə: jənəʊ. Eng muhimi pauzaning joyi. Pauza mazmunli bo‘laklar orasida bo‘lsin: I think, pauza, the main reason is, pauza, cost. Bo‘lak ichida, masalan, the dan keyin to‘xtasangiz, nutq ikkilanayotgandek eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Stretch well with a level tone, and people know you're continuing. Say you know with a weak you. And pause between chunks: I think... the main reason is... cost. Not in the middle of one.
scenes.say_uz: Well ni tekis ohangda cho‘zing, shunda davom etishingiz tushuniladi. You know da you kuchsiz. Bo‘laklar orasida to‘xtang: menimcha... asosiy sabab... narx. Bo‘lak o‘rtasida emas.

scenes.title: Tabiiy pauza qiling
board: Replace “eee / haligi” and say aloud:
1) Eee… I think it’s important.
2) It was, haligi, quite expensive.
3) Q: What’s the best age to marry? → (buy time)
scenes.say_native: Uchta gap. Birinchi va ikkinchisida eee va haligi o‘rniga tabiiy inglizcha to‘ldiruvchi qo‘yib, ovoz chiqarib ayting. Uchinchisi savol: what’s the best age to marry? Vaqt yutadigan ibora bilan boshlang va bitta gap bilan javob bering. Pauzani bo‘laklar orasiga qo‘yishni unutmang.
scenes.say: Replace the hesitation sounds with natural fillers. Eee, I think it's important. It was, haligi, quite expensive. Then answer: what's the best age to marry?
scenes.say_uz: Ikkilanish tovushlarini tabiiy to‘ldiruvchilar bilan almashtiring. Eee, menimcha, bu muhim. Bu, haligi, ancha qimmat edi. Keyin javob bering: turmush qurishning eng yaxshi yoshi qaysi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Well… I think it’s important.
2) It was… kind of expensive, actually.
3) That’s a tricky question. I suppose it depends on the person…
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: well, I think it’s important, well cho‘ziq va tekis. Ikkinchi: it was kind of expensive, actually; bu yerda actually “aslida” ma’nosida, to‘g‘ri ishlatilgan. Uchinchi: that’s a tricky question. I suppose it depends on the person. Boshqa variantlar ham to‘g‘ri, muhimi, eee va haligi o‘rnida inglizcha so‘z bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Well, I think it's important. It was kind of expensive, actually. That's a tricky question. I suppose it depends on the person.
scenes.say_uz: Xo‘sh, menimcha, bu muhim. Bu aslida ancha qimmat edi. Qiyin savol ekan. Menimcha, bu odamga bog‘liq.

scenes.title: Tinglash: imtihondagi nutq
board: Listen: Bekzod describes a festival
Q1 How does he buy time at the start?
Q2 How does he correct himself?
Q3 Which word does he describe instead of naming?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash. Bekzod imtihonda bayram haqida gapiradi. Uch savol. Birinchi: u boshida qanday vaqt yutadi? Ikkinchi: o‘zini qanday tuzatadi? Uchinchi: qaysi so‘zni aytish o‘rniga tavsiflaydi? Bugungi to‘rttala texnikani eshitasiz. Tinglab bo‘lgach, savollarga javob berishdan oldin qaysi joylarda u to‘xtab qolishi mumkin bo‘lganini ham o‘ylab ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Well, let me think. I'd like to talk about Navruz. Every year, my family makes sumalak. It takes, I mean, it took about twenty hours last year. We stir it in a huge, how can I put it, a kind of giant metal pot. Then again, the best part isn't the food, it's the people. You know, neighbours I hardly see all year come and help.
scenes.say_uz: Xo‘sh, o‘ylab ko‘ray. Navro‘z haqida gapirmoqchiman. Har yili oilam sumalak pishiradi. Bu taxminan, ya’ni o‘tgan yili yigirma soat davom etdi. Biz uni ulkan, qanday desam, bir xil katta metall qozonda aralashtiramiz. Yana o‘ylab ko‘rsam, eng yaxshi tomoni taom emas, odamlar. Bilasizmi, yil bo‘yi deyarli ko‘rmaydigan qo‘shnilar kelib yordam beradi.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: Q1 How does Bekzod buy time?
Q2 How does he correct himself?
Q3 What does he describe instead of naming?
Q4 What is the best part, in his opinion?
scenes.say_native: Javob bering. Birinchi: Bekzod boshida qaysi ibora bilan vaqt yutadi? Ikkinchi: o‘zini qaysi so‘z bilan tuzatadi? Uchinchi: qaysi narsani nomlash o‘rniga tavsiflaydi? To‘rtinchi: uning fikricha, bayramning eng yaxshi tomoni nima? Javoblarni inglizcha ayting.
scenes.say: How does Bekzod buy time? How does he correct himself? What does he describe instead of naming? And what's the best part for him?
scenes.say_uz: Bekzod qanday vaqt yutadi? O‘zini qanday tuzatadi? Nimani nomlash o‘rniga tavsiflaydi? Uning uchun eng yaxshi tomoni nima?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Well, let me think.
2) It takes, I mean, it took…
3) a kind of giant metal pot (= qozon)
4) The people, not the food.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: well, let me think. Ikkinchi: it takes, I mean, it took, zamonni tez tuzatdi va davom etdi. Uchinchi: qozon so‘zini tavsifladi, a kind of giant metal pot, oldidan how can I put it bilan vaqt yutdi. To‘rtinchi: eng yaxshi tomoni odamlar, then again bilan kiritilgan qarama-qarshilik. Bekzodda xatolar bor edi, lekin nutq bir lahza ham to‘xtamadi.
scenes.say: He buys time with well, let me think. He corrects himself with I mean. He describes a kazan as a kind of giant metal pot. And for him, the best part is the people.
scenes.say_uz: U well, let me think bilan vaqt yutadi. I mean bilan o‘zini tuzatadi. Qozonni bir xil ulkan metall idish deb tavsiflaydi. Uning uchun eng yaxshi tomoni odamlar.

scenes.title: Ikki daqiqalik xarita
board: 0:00 Opening (well… I’d like to talk about…)
0:10 Background (who / when / where)
0:40 Main story + example
1:20 Contrast (then again…)
1:45 Feelings / future → close
scenes.say_native: Hammasini birlashtiramiz. Ikki daqiqalik xarita. Birinchi o‘n soniya: kirish. Keyingi o‘ttiz soniya: fon, kim, qachon, qayerda. Keyin qirq soniya: asosiy voqea va aniq misol. Keyin yigirma besh soniya: then again bilan qarama-qarshilik. Oxirgi yigirma soniya: his-tuyg‘u yoki kelajak va yakun. Bu taxminiy xarita, soniyalarni sanash shart emas, lekin har bo‘lim borligini tekshiring.
scenes.say: Here's a rough map. Ten seconds to open. Thirty for background. Forty for the main story and an example. Twenty-five for a contrast. And the last twenty for feelings or the future.
scenes.say_uz: Mana taxminiy xarita. O‘n soniya kirish. O‘ttiz soniya fon. Qirq soniya asosiy voqea va misol. Yigirma besh soniya qarama-qarshilik. Oxirgi yigirma soniya his-tuyg‘u yoki kelajak.

scenes.title: Mashq qilish tartibi
board: Week 1: 1 minute · Week 2: 1.5 minutes · Week 3: 2 minutes
Random topic → 1 min notes → speak → record
Listen back: pauses? fillers? corrections?
scenes.say_native: Ravonlik mashq bilan keladi. Birinchi hafta bir daqiqa, ikkinchi hafta bir yarim, uchinchi hafta ikki daqiqa. Har kuni tasodifiy mavzu tanlang, bir daqiqa qayd yozing, gapiring va telefonga yozib oling. Keyin tinglang: qayerda uzoq to‘xtadingiz, qaysi to‘ldiruvchi ko‘p takrorlandi, tuzatishlar qisqa bo‘ldimi? Kuniga besh daqiqa ham bir oyda katta farq beradi.
scenes.say: Build up gradually: one minute, then one and a half, then two. Pick a random topic, make notes, speak, record yourself, and listen back. Five minutes a day makes a real difference.
scenes.say_uz: Asta-sekin oshiring: bir daqiqa, keyin bir yarim, keyin ikki. Tasodifiy mavzu tanlang, qayd yozing, gapiring, o‘zingizni yozib oling va qayta tinglang. Kuniga besh daqiqa ham haqiqiy farq beradi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: 2 daqiqa
board: Topic: a decision that changed your life
1 min notes (5W + H) → 2 min speech
Use: 1 example · 1 contrast · fillers · quick repairs
Record yourself
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Mavzu: hayotingizni o‘zgartirgan qaror. Darsni to‘xtating. Bir daqiqa qayd yozing, keyin ikki daqiqa to‘xtamasdan gapiring va o‘zingizni yozib oling. Kamida bitta aniq misol, bitta qarama-qarshilik, tabiiy to‘ldiruvchilar va qisqa tuzatishlar bo‘lsin. Ikki daqiqaga yetmasangiz, xaritadagi qaysi bo‘lim yo‘qligini toping.
scenes.say: Final task. Topic: a decision that changed your life. One minute of notes, then two minutes of speech. Record yourself.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy topshiriq. Mavzu: hayotingizni o‘zgartirgan qaror. Bir daqiqa qayd, keyin ikki daqiqa nutq. O‘zingizni yozib oling.

scenes.title: Namunaviy nutqdan parcha
board: Well, I’d like to talk about moving to Tashkent…
Take my first week, for example…
Having said that, I really miss…
Looking back, it was the right call.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy nutqning boshlanishi va oxiri. Kirish: well, I’d like to talk about. Aniq misol: take my first week, for example, metroda adashganim. Qarama-qarshilik: having said that, I really miss my hometown. Yakun: looking back, it was the right call, orqaga qarasam, to‘g‘ri qaror edi. O‘rtadagi bo‘limlarni siz o‘z tajribangiz bilan to‘ldirasiz.
scenes.say: Well, I'd like to talk about moving to Tashkent for university. Take my first week, for example: I got lost on the metro three times. Having said that, I really miss my hometown. Looking back, though, it was the right call.
scenes.say_uz: Xo‘sh, universitet uchun Toshkentga ko‘chishim haqida gapirmoqchiman. Masalan, birinchi haftamni oling: metroda uch marta adashdim. Shunday bo‘lsa-da, ona shahrimni juda sog‘inaman. Lekin orqaga qarasam, bu to‘g‘ri qaror edi.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Ideas: 5W + H · timeline · personal → general
Expand: point → reason → example → contrast → link
Repair: or rather · I mean · describe the word
Fillers: well · let me think · in moderation
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. G‘oya uchun: oltita savol, vaqt chizig‘i, shaxsiydan umumiyga. Kengaytirish uchun: fikr, sabab, misol, qarama-qarshilik, qaytish. Tuzatish uchun: or rather, I mean, va so‘z topilmasa tavsif; hech qachon boshidan boshlamang. To‘ldiruvchilar uchun: well, let me think, you know, lekin me’yorida, eee va haligi o‘rniga. Va eng muhimi: ravonlik mukammallikdan oldin.
scenes.say: Generate ideas with six questions or a timeline. Expand with reasons, examples and contrast. Repair quickly and keep going. And fill pauses with English, in moderation.
scenes.say_uz: G‘oyalarni olti savol yoki vaqt chizig‘i bilan toping. Sabab, misol va qarama-qarshilik bilan kengaytiring. Tez tuzating va davom eting. Pauzalarni me’yorida inglizcha so‘zlar bilan to‘ldiring.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Speak for 2 minutes on 3 random topics
Record each one
Check: 2 min · 1 example · 1 contrast · no restarts
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Uchta tasodifiy mavzu tanlang, masalan, sevimli taom, eng yaxshi o‘qituvchi va kelajakdagi texnologiya. Har biriga bir daqiqa tayyorlanib, ikki daqiqa gapiring va yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir nutq kamida ikki daqiqa, unda aniq misol va qarama-qarshilik bor, gap boshidan qayta boshlanmagan. Keyingi darsda abstrakt mavzularda fikr yuritishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, speak for two minutes on three random topics, and record each one. Next time: thinking and talking about abstract topics.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: uchta tasodifiy mavzuda ikki daqiqadan gapiring va har birini yozib oling. Keyingi safar: abstrakt mavzularda fikr yuritish.

homework_uz: Uchta tasodifiy mavzuda (masalan, sevimli taom, eng yaxshi o‘qituvchi, kelajakdagi texnologiya) har biriga 1 daqiqa tayyorlanib, 2 daqiqa gapiring va yozib oling. Mezon: har bir nutq kamida 2 daqiqa, unda kamida bitta aniq misol va bitta qarama-qarshilik bor, gap boshidan qayta boshlanmagan.

quiz.q: You run out of ideas mid-answer. What is the best thing to say?
options: I don't know what to say.
quiz.why_uz: O‘tish iborasi yangi g‘oyaga ko‘prik bo‘ladi va vaqt beradi.

options: On the other hand, it's expensive.
At the other hand, it's expensive.
quiz.why_uz: To‘g‘ri ibora: on the other hand.

options: Despite of the rain, we went out.
Despite that the rain, we went out.
Despite the rain, we went out.
In spite the rain, we went out.
quiz.why_uz: Despite dan keyin of yo‘q; in spite of da esa of bor.

quiz.q: You said "Monday" but meant "Tuesday". What is the most natural repair?
quiz.why_uz: Or rather bilan qisqa tuzatib, davom etish ravonlikni saqlaydi.

quiz.q: You can't remember the word "landlord". What do you say?
options: the person who owns the flat you rent
quiz.why_uz: So‘z topilmasa, o‘z tilingizga o‘tmang, inglizcha tavsiflang.

quiz.q: Which mistake should you usually NOT stop to correct?
quiz.why_uz: Ma’noni o‘zgartirmaydigan kichik xatolarni qo‘yib yuboring.

quiz.q: Which is a natural English filler?
quiz.why_uz: Pauzani inglizcha to‘ldiring: well, let me think.
Actual = haqiqiy; ruscha актуальный esa current yoki pressing.

quiz.q: Where is the most natural place to pause?
options: I think the | main reason is cost.
I | think the main | reason is cost.
I think the main | reason | is cost.
I think | the main reason is | cost.
quiz.why_uz: Pauza mazmunli bo‘laklar orasida bo‘ladi, bo‘lak ichida emas.

quiz.q: Which order follows the expansion formula?
options: point → reason → example → contrast → link back
quiz.why_uz: Fikr, sabab, misol, qarama-qarshilik va asosiy fikrga qaytish.
